insight: Founded as Hello Cognition (YC S22); raised $10.4M led by Bessemer in late 2025.
name: Phind
tagline: AI answer engine for developers — technical search with code and citations.
description: Phind is a conversational search engine built for developers: it combines live web results with generative AI to answer technical questions, returning explanations, code snippets, and cited sources. It uses multi-step reasoning over documentation and the web, and integrates into the editor via a VS Code extension. A free tier covers everyday use, with Plus and Pro plans adding stronger models, longer context, and higher limits.

modelSupport.notes: Routes across frontier LLMs plus Phind's own models, depending on plan.

edge: Tunes search for programmers — answers come as code and steps with cited sources, not ranked links.
cons: Best models gated to paid plans
Deep IDE support mainly VS Code
